text.overview: Off Skookum's north ridge stands Jaw's Tooth, a shark-tooth pinnacle of 65 feet; the two combine into a fine route. Start in the basin northwest of Skookum and zigzag upward through fourth class and low fifth class ground to the striking layback corner, a sustained, very high quality 5.6 pitch. Easy ground leads to the tooth's summit. Getting down into the southern notch means either a rappel off tat or a low 5th downclimb.
